# homarr_apps (Data Source)

Lists every Homarr app visible to the configured API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "homarr_apps" "all" {}

output "app_names" {
  value = [for app in data.homarr_apps.all.apps : app.name]
}

# Handy for finding apps that have no health check configured.
output "apps_without_ping" {
  value = [for app in data.homarr_apps.all.apps : app.name if app.ping_url == null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) All apps, in the order Homarr returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the app.
- `href` (String) URL the app tile links to.
- `icon_url` (String) Icon URL of the app.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the app.
- `name` (String) Name of the app.
- `ping_url` (String) URL Homarr pings for the app's online status.
